deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: staged rollout v2.8.1 -> 5% traffic across eu-west & us-central. Change window 2024-11-07 11:00-12:00 UTC. Bake: 15m. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 1.5% OR p99 latency +30% vs baseline. Rolling out now. /deploy id=98532

maria: Quick Q — does this overlap with the telemetry schema PR scheduled at 11:30?

aj: yes, telemetry PR merges at 11:20. Might overlap on the infra agent. Recommend pinning canary to us-central only for first 10m.

ops-sre: Heads up — we have a KV-cache eviction job at 11:05 on eu-west; suggest avoid eu-west until after 11:20.

sam: Can we pin to region? deploy-bot, what's the current plan?

deploy-bot: plan: 5% split: eu-west 60% of canary, us-central 40%. canary_nodes: [eu-west-a, eu-west-b, us-central-a]

lina: hold — release notes missing changelog entry + migration steps. ping @product for approval. :warning:

product-bot: Confirmed. Adding entry now: https://redwood/release/notes/98532

maria: vote: hold until product updates. :raised_hand:

aj: vote: hold, agree to pin to us-central if urgent.

ops-sre: If we proceed, set autoscale min=2 and drain_timeout=45s. Also enable kv warmup on canary nodes.

ops-sre: ```
kubectl annotate deployment inference --overwrite redwood/traffic=canary
deployctl rollout --id 98532 --regions us-central --percent 5
```

deploy-bot: Hold recorded. Staging rollout paused. To resume run `/deploy resume 98532` or react :thumbsup: to continue.

sam: I'll wait for product confirmation. If we resume, prefer us-central only for first 10m.

product-bot: Done — release note now includes migration steps and data-retention notes. ready to proceed? :white_check_mark:

maria: ok from eng. :thumbsup:

aj: I'm good. ops-sre ok with us-central pin.

ops-sre: Set queue_batch=64 and enable kv_warmup=true for canary nodes.

deploy-bot: Resuming rollout pinned to us-central for 10m then reevaluate. Started at 4159876600. Rolling 5%.
